source.quote: NII grew quarter-on-quarter by 1.3% and finished the year in line with our guidance, as a positive evolution of the commercial activity was more than offset by the lower contribution from the ALCO portfolio and the IFRS 16 impact.
For 2020, we expect the reduction of cost of deposits to continue and NII to decrease at low single-digit, improving on first half trends.
It was also supported by higher net trading income mainly due to higher ALCO portfolio sales and a remarkable improvement in operating expenses down over 6% above expectations.

In general, Q3 net attributable profit recovers significantly versus the previous quarter in all countries.In Colombia, net attributable profit in Q3 increased 42% versus Q2 in constant euros explained by core revenue growth, strong NTI, and a reduction in impairments favored by lower and NPL entries and higher recoveries reduced in year-to-date cost of risk to 298 basis points and in line with expectations.
For 2020, for 2020 we expect core revenues to continue growing, supported by fees that will increase by high single-digit.

For 2021 and according to our current tech scenario, we expect that the following trends, first, NII to grow by mid single-digit, growing slightly above activity due to the expected improvement of customer spread, as we will continue to focus on price management.

source.quote: For '21, we maintain our guidance of mid-single-digit growth in NII, supported by both activity in retail segments and customer spreads, which will evolve positively and will become -- will be above 2020 levels.
For 2021, we expect NII to grow at mid-single digits, levered on activity growth and margin improvements.
We expect the improving NII trend to continue in the fourth quarter, ending 2021 with a high single-digit increase.
